summary.headline: 58 unique privately managed institutions have a currently date-valid ICAR accreditation entry in the checked published 2026 lists.
summary.scope: Agriculture and allied degree programmes. Private includes privately managed aided colleges and private deemed universities. A university is counted once when one or more of its schools/programmes is listed; this is not a claim that every course or campus of that university is accredited.
summary.arithmetic: 62 List-II rows - 3 printed expired terms - 1 public constituent college - 1 duplicate Centurion university row + 1 privately managed aided college from List III = 58 unique institutions.
summary.publication_note: 2026 official files downloaded from the live ICAR publication page. A site-wide footer last-update value is not treated as a file version or accreditation renewal.

additional_verified_evidence.finding: The linked official letter was downloaded and its scanned first page visually read. Letter dated 3 September 2021 grants 17 August 2021–16 August 2026, not a renewal beyond 2026.
The institution marks grant-in-aid funding and describes its management. Its UGC listing labels it Non Government.
Affiliating public university explicitly states that the college is run by Shri Shivaji Education Society.

additional_verified_evidence.institution: Sri Kinjarapu Yerran Naidu College of Agricultural Sciences
additional_verified_evidence.finding: Official AISHE directory search record labels C-56759 Private Un-Aided, affiliated to ANGRAU.
SRMIST official curriculum identifies this as its Faculty/College of Agricultural Sciences, so it belongs to one private deemed university rather than an independent affiliated college.

limits: This is a reproducible current-date-valid count from the checked published records, not confirmation that the national register includes every new or renewed accreditation issued after the workbook update.
No dated renewal decision was found for TMU, Vanavarayar or ADT Baramati during targeted official-site checks. Their generic marketing claims were not used to extend printed validity.
SHUATS is absent from the checked current lists. Historical accreditation and generic ICAR-admission wording do not establish a current dated term, so it is not added.
The strict B.Sc. Agriculture count follows the specific programme labels printed in the source. It does not infer accreditation for an unlisted programme from an accredited institution.
